items.title: Michi Fuji interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: For jazz I was listening at that time to Coltrane and Miles. Miles Davis.

ctx.x: In jazz, later, yeah. For jazz I was listening at that time to Coltrane and Miles. Miles Davis. And then, oh I heard Stephane Grappelli. I tried to listen to that.
